_comment: e2e scenarios for e2e_check.py. Key = plugin id. Fields: observable_type, observable_value, settings (non-secret config), secrets_env (secret param -> env var to read it from, so no secrets live here), expect {verdict?, source?, normalized?}. DETERMINISTIC/offline plugins (observable-validator) can assert a verdict. Plugins that call a LIVE vendor should assert only 'source' (verdict depends on live data) and use a generous CATLICO_E2E_TIMEOUT. Some vendors are slow/rate-limited (crt.sh can exceed the plugin's 30s timeout) — pick a fast one like ip-api for a reliable smoke test.
